page_title: INT 1-2 UDI | Inter v Udinese 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+5' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) is penalised.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) swings in a cross from the corner, but Razvan Sava reads it well and gathers the ball.

89' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
86' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
85' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
83' Today's match ends for Federico Dimarco who will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
83' Here is a change. Francesco Acerbi is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
83' Substitution. Nicolo Barella makes his way off the pitch and Piotr Zielinski (Inter) comes on as his replacement.
82' Federico Dimarco (Inter) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
82' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
81' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
80' It's time for a substitution. Rui Modesto (Udinese) comes on in place of Kingsley Ehizibue.
79' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
79' Federico Dimarco (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Razvan Sava (Udinese) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
75' Federico Dimarco (Inter) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter. Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
74' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
73' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the left post.
72' Yann Bisseck (Inter) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
70' Substitution. Keinan Davis will be replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
70' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Jakub Piotrowski and he is replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
69' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) for Hakan Calhanoglu.
66' Udinese produce a short pass from the free kick.
65' Federico Dimarco (Inter) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
63' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Petar Sucic will be replaced by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adam Buksa (Udinese) will replace Vakoun Issouf Bayo.
62' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
61' Fine play by Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the right post.
58' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to an offside in the build-up play.
57' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Matteo Marchetti makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

56' 1:2. Federico Dimarco (Inter) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is! Razvan Sava did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Marcus Thuram provided the assistance.
55' That was close by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.

54' Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
49' That was close! Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
46' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Kosta Runjaic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Nicolo Bertola (Udinese). He is replaced by Saba Goglichidze.
46' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle as Yann Bisseck (Inter) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
40' 1 - 2 Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
38' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Federico Dimarco (Inter) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
33' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
32' A clumsy foul by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle. Udinese will take a free kick near the side line.
31' Arthur Atta (Udinese) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
31' Oumar Solet (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
29' 1 - 1 Goal! Keinan Davis (Udinese) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yann Sommer into the bottom right corner.
28' Keinan Davis (Udinese) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
28' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Udinese!

26' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Udinese.
26' That looked a certain handball by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
25' Oumar Solet (Udinese) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
23' Arthur Atta (Udinese) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
21' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
21' Oumar Solet (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) scores after an assist by Marcus Thuram that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
14' Inter fail to score from a corner as Razvan Sava (Udinese) leaps to collect the ball.
9' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
7' The Inter players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' The ball is laid off to Arthur Atta (Udinese) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Yann Sommer to make a decent save.
3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
2' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
1' Marcus Thuram (Inter) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Udinese will kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti will officiate today.
